params.body:
The workbench preview is moving from the pull request's head to GitHub's test merge of the pull request onto the current base (`merge_commit_sha`): what you see on the preview site is what you get after merging. The client (`hand.mjs preview`) then wants the record to say onto which base that merge was made.

This adds `base` (hex40) as an optional parameter of `preview.push`, beside `pull` and `head`. Nothing about the policy changes: still the branch named `preview` and no other, once per run, deploy after push. A schema test covers a full id accepted and a branch name refused; `docs/preview.md` names the field.

Until the VM runs this release the client sends `base` and falls back to the old parameter set when the gateway refuses it as out of schema.
params.title: preview.push: optional base parameter
